body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Motorola(www.motorola.com) unveiled tablet PC 'XOOM' with Google's 'Honeycomb' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January.
'XOOM' has loaded 10.1-inch display. 'Honeycomb' is OS that Google has developed targeting Tablet devices and it is Android 3.0 unlike smartphones which are staying on 2.3.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
